sentences.text: VIVEK RAY @ VIVEK KUMAR Son of Govind Ray R/o Village- Garha  Baharam, P.S.- Paru, District- Muzaffarpur

... .
 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. RATAN KUMARI W/o Vivek Kumar R/o Village- Garha Baharam, P.S.-
 Paru, District- Muzaffarpur, At present D/o Late Budhan Ray, R/v-  Bakhtaurganj, P.S. and District- Vaishali  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Satya Prakash Sinha  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Umeshanand Pandit  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 4 16-02-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Goraul P.S. Case No. 66 of 2020 registered under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and  of the D.P. Act.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

Further he submits that the informant/wife of the petitioner has already solemnized her second marriage with one Pappu Kumar and she is living with him, as is evident from Annexure-2 to the bail application.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.60365 of 2022(4) dt.16-02-2023

Having considered the above facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of C.J.M., Vaishali at Hajipur in connection with Goraul P.S. Case No. 66 of 2020, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr. P.C.
